text: At the September 18, 2025 meeting of Toronto and East York Community Council, accessible parking spaces were approved on Chudleigh Road and Morrison Avenue. The accessible parking space on Chudleigh Street is not sufficient in length for the original applicant’s vehicle and, therefore, is no longer needed. The location of the accessible parking space on Morrison Avenue will be relocated to better meet the needs of the applicant. As a year has not passed since the adoption of this item, a motion is required to re-open and rescind the installation of the above accessible parking spaces and approve the installation of the relocated accessible parking space on Morrison Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item TE25.42 titled "Accessible Parking Spaces - September 2025 (Delegated)”. 2.
